headline: GREEN: Sofia openers logged, taper unchanged
summary: Readiness green: HRV 62 (5 down from 67, under the 10 drop limit), RHR 49, sleep 7.0h. This morning's run: 8.5km in 51min, load 31 vs 35 planned, RPE 2, feel 2 (Good). Max HR 173 shows you reached race HR (162-168) at some point. The 127bpm average over 51min is low for 3x4min at 162-168 plus strides, though. From the summary alone I can't confirm you did all 3 reps at full length. You ran 9min longer than the ~42min prescribed and the load landed 4 short. That doesn't matter 3 days out. Tuesday was a 40min spin (load 36) instead of the 35min run (30): also fine. Fitness check: CTL 56.0, ATL 60.7, so form (TSB) is -4.7. Running Thu 25 and Fri 15 as planned projects race morning at about CTL 54.3 and TSB about +4.5. That's inside the +2 to +5 target and close to the 55 CTL target. The taper stays as written. Thu: 23min easy at 138-150bpm plus 4 strides in Milan, and start carb loading at 7-8 g/kg.
flags: Average cadence 81 (~162 spm) is below your usual 82-85 on flat. On Thu and Fri, run the strides with quick feet and aim for 172+ spm on race descents.
If the 3x4min weren't done in full, don't make them up. Thursday's strides are enough to keep race speed sharp.
